title: Decrypt Service State
description: Decrypts a base64-encoded AES-256-GCM ciphertext produced by the Encrypt service. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/decrypt)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

secret.description: Shared secret used to derive the decryption key

method.description: Encryption method (only AES-GCM is currently supported)
